videos.title: EWTN News In-Depth
videos.description: Roundtable discussions unapologetically examining and analyzing important issues and events from a strictly Catholic perspective.

videos.title: EWTN News Nightly
videos.description: Daily news and analysis, from Washington, D.C.

videos.title: Fathers for Good
videos.description: Fr. Francis Gustilo and Frank Padilla discuss the need to care for the poor in our communities and around the world; they conclude the series with a challenge to all men to follow the perfect will of God.

videos.title: Angels of God
videos.description: Fr. John Horgan presents the Church's comforting teaching on the wondrous life of the Angels of God. He relates that God has created these spiritual beings for our help and for his praise. See why spiritual formation with the angels is so powerful.

videos.title: At Home With Jim and Joy
videos.description: Dynamic husband and wife radio team Jim and Joy Pinto bring their powerful witness to daytime TV with special guests and topics focusing on marriage, family and pro-life issues.

videos.title: Savoring Our Faith
videos.description: Father Leo Patalinghug goes on the Rhine River Cruise Pilgrimage and explores the influence of Catholicism.

videos.title: The Holy Rosary With Mother Angelica
videos.description: Mother Angelica and the Poor Clares of Perpetual Adoration recite the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Ala.

videos.title: From the Heart, With Mother Angelica
videos.description: Mother Angelica talks about why some stay away from God, and how she can encourage them to return to church, encounter the saints, discover spirituality and come to know the divine indwelling as God living within them.

videos.title: Catholics Come Home
videos.description: Steve Ray recounts his journey from once convincing Catholics to leave their faith, to now being a renowned evangelist helping people come home to Jesus and the Catholic Church.

videos.title: EWTN Religious Catalogue
videos.description: Celebrate your faith as EWTN Religious Catalogue presents a unique array of religious items - from books and paintings to rosaries and statues - and everything in between.

videos.title: Saints of China: Martyrs of the Middle Kingdom
videos.description: Dr. Anthony Clark is joined by Fr. Paul Mariani, S.J. to discuss the challenges and triumphs of the Catholic Church in China today as it struggles and flourishes under Communist rule.

videos.title: The Chaplet of St. Michael
videos.description: Mother Angelica and the Nuns of Our Lady of the Angels Monastery ask for the intercession of the Prince of the Heavenly Hosts and the nine Choirs of Angels, as they pray the chaplet of St. Michael.

videos.title: Holy Land Rosary
videos.description: Fr. Mitch Pacwa leads the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the actual holy sites and shrines where they took place, bringing the Gospels to life and offering a deeper understanding of the Rosary meditations.

videos.title: The Litany of the Blessed Virgin Mary
videos.description: A beautiful prayer in honor of the Blessed Virgin Mary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Alabama.

videos.title: Daily Mass
videos.description: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, Ala.

videos.title: Chesterton Station
videos.description: Chesterton and George Bernard Shaw face off in a showdown and learn more about life, faith and death.

videos.title: When Children Adore
videos.description: Father Thomas asks why John the Baptist said, "Behold the Lamb," when he introduced Jesus.

videos.title: The Massterpiece Donut Shop
videos.description: Wendy and Duncan ignore the donut cookbook and create a new flavor that tastes so awful that the Donut Man has to close the shop; Fr. Joe teaches the kids why they must follow God's commandments and listen to His Word.

videos.title: My Catholic Family
videos.description: Thomas and Helen teach their children Alex and Sarah about the lives and charisms of the Catholic Church's greatest saints, in this delightful animated series that reconnects families and inspires children of all ages. After Sister Patricia teaches about St. Cecilia, Sergio and Martin forgive one another as she forgave her executioners, while Sara seeks her intercession before a big piano exam.

videos.title: At Home With Jim and Joy
videos.description: Dynamic husband and wife radio team Jim and Joy Pinto bring their powerful witness to daytime TV with special guests and topics focusing on marriage, family and pro-life issues.

videos.title: Bob and Penny Lord Present
videos.description: Bob and Penny Lord reflect on the life of St. Frances Cabrini, an Italian-American saint who founded the Missionary Sisters of the Sacred Heart of Jesus.

videos.title: Daily Mass: Olam Daily Mass
videos.description: The Franciscan Missionaries of the Eternal Word celebrate the Holy Sacrifice of the Mass from the Our Lady of Angels Chapel in Irondale, Ala.

videos.title: EWTN Religious Catalogue
videos.description: Celebrate your faith as EWTN Religious Catalogue presents a unique array of religious items - from books and paintings to rosaries and statues - and everything in between.

videos.title: Dominican Sisters of Mary, Mother of the Eucharist
videos.description: A discussion of the sacraments of initiation and grace in Catholic education and teaching, with Sr. John Dominic, Dr. Karen Villa, and guest Mother Amata Veritas.

videos.title: All Shall Be Well: The Revelations of Blessed Julian of Norwich
videos.description: The counsel, ministry, and faith of the 14th Century mystic, Blessed Julian of Norwich, comes to life in this EWTN original docudrama.

videos.title: The Chaplet of Divine Mercy
videos.description: Devotional prayer from the chapel of the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy in Stockbridge, Mass.

videos.title: Live Adoration From EWTN Chapel
videos.description: Priests conduct adoration at Our Lady of the Angels Chapel in Irondale, Alabama.

videos.title: The Holy Rosary With Mother Angelica
videos.description: Mother Angelica and the Poor Clares of Perpetual Adoration recite the Joyful Mysteries of the Rosary from the Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament in Hanceville, Ala.

videos.title: Called to Communion with Dr. David Anders
videos.description: David Anders questions atheists, former Catholics and non-Catholics, while answering questions about the Eucharist, the Douay-Rheims Bible translation and the relationship of the Catholic Church to the seven churches mentioned in Revelation.

videos.title: The Fourth Cup: Unveiling the Mystery of the Last Supper and the Cross
videos.description: Dr. Scott Hahn and Mike Aquilina reveal how Passover was the first holiday to be celebrated by the Christian Church and led to the celebration of Easter and the development of Lent in the Catholic Church.

videos.title: The Gospel of Life vs. the Culture of Death
videos.description: Father Wade Menezes shows how the culture of death attacks the dignity of the human person.

videos.title: Explore With the Miracle Hunter
videos.description: Miracle hunter Michael O'Neill journeys to miracle sites to introduce viewers to these important events in church history and the saints who lived them.

videos.title: Saving Private Ryan
videos.description: Captain John Miller (Tom Hanks) takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honor, decency and courage.

videos.title: The General's Daughter
videos.description: When the body of Army Capt. Elizabeth Campbell (Leslie Stefanson) is found on a Georgia military base, two investigators, Warrant Officers Paul Brenner (John Travolta) and Sara Sunhill (Madeleine Stowe), are ordered to solve her murder. What they uncover is anything but clear-cut. Unseemly details emerge about Campbell's life, leading to allegations of a possible military coverup of her death and the involvement of her father, Lt. Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell).

videos.title: Ghost
videos.description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

videos.title: Selena
videos.description: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete.

videos.title: Beautiful Girls
videos.description: An all-star cast sparks this captivating comedy about a group of old friends whose 10-year high school reunion creates some hilariously unexpected surprises. Willie (Timothy Hutton), Tommy (Matt Dillon), and Paul may have lost a bit of their youth, but they're still ready to party with Uma Thurman, Rosie O'Donnell, Lauren Holly, and Mira Sorvino -- the beautiful girls who've turned their lives upside down!

videos.title: Hugo
videos.description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

videos.title: Shall We Dance?
videos.description: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

videos.title: Footloose
videos.description: Moving in from Chicago, newcomer Ren McCormack (Kevin Bacon) is in shock when he discovers the small Midwestern town he now calls home has made dancing and rock music illegal. As he struggles to fit in, Ren faces an uphill battle to change things. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way.

videos.title: Cold Mountain
videos.description: In this classic story of love and devotion set against the backdrop of the American Civil War, a wounded Confederate soldier named W.P. Inman (Jude Law) deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada (Nicole Kidman), who he left behind to tend their farm. As Inman makes his perilous journey home, Ada struggles to keep their home intact with the assistance of Ruby (Renée Zellweger), a mysterious drifter sent to help her by a kindly neighbor.

videos.title: Tarzan

Falling in love with Jane, Tarzan is torn between embracing civilization and staying with his gorilla family, which becomes threatened by the ruthless hunter Clayton (Brian Blessed).

videos.description: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

videos.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch

When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

videos.title: Home Alone

But his excitement sours when he realizes that two con men plan to rob the McCallister residence, and that he alone must protect the family home.

videos.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
videos.description: After snarky youth Kevin McCallister loses track of his father at the airport, he mistakenly gets on a plane headed for New York City -- while the rest of the McCallisters fly to Florida. Now alone in the Big Apple, Kevin cons his way into a room at the Plaza Hotel and begins his usual antics. But when Kevin discovers that the Sticky Bandits are on the loose, he struggles to stop them from robbing an elderly man's toy store just before Christmas.

videos.title: See How They Run
videos.description: In the 1950s London, plans for a movie version of a smash-hit play come to an abrupt halt after a pivotal member of the crew is murdered. When a world-weary inspector and an eager rookie constable take on the case, they find themselves thrown into a puzzling whodunit within the glamorously sordid world of underground theater, investigating the mysterious homicide at their own peril.

videos.title: The Duke
videos.description: In 1961, a 60-year-old taxi driver steals Goya's portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in London. He sends ransom notes saying that he will return the painting if the government invests more in care for the elderly.

videos.title: Two for the Road
videos.description: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart.

videos.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
videos.description: Lorelei Lee (Marilyn Monroe) is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond (Tommy Noonan), much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage.

videos.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular
videos.description: A showgirl from the San Francisco cabaret is murdered, and the only witnesses are fellow showgirls Stormy Tornado (Betty Grable) and Curly Flagg (Sheree North). Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown.

videos.title: 9 to 5
videos.description: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant.

videos.title: Working Girl
videos.description: Savvy New York City receptionist Tess McGill (Melanie Griffith) gives her conniving boss, Katharine Parker (Sigourney Weaver), an excellent business tip, but Katharine simply steals the idea without giving due credit to her secretary. After Katharine winds up in the hospital with an injured leg, Tess decides to exact revenge. Pretending to be her boss, Tess initiates a major deal with an investment broker (Harrison Ford) -- but things turn ugly after Katharine finds out what Tess has been up to.

videos.title: Moulin Rouge
videos.description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman).

videos.title: Long Weekend
videos.description: An enchanted weekend courtship leads to unexpected revelations between a young man and woman who harbor deep secrets.

videos.title: The Broken Hearts Gallery
videos.description: Dumped by her boyfriend, a New York art gallery assistant creates an exhibit for souvenirs from past relationships.

Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway.

videos.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
videos.description: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

Ned refuses to fight, which disappoints fellow passenger Flora Talbot (Phyllis Thaxter), who had taken a liking to him but now sees him as weak. In Fort Worth, Ned discovers Clevenger is battling the burgeoning railroad and decides to fight back using the power of the press.

videos.title: The Bounty Hunter
videos.description: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. videos.title: Final Destination 5
videos.description: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied.

videos.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
videos.description: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

videos.title: The Hole in the Ground
videos.description: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

videos.title: Chernobyl: The Lost Tapes
videos.description: The story of Chernobyl told through a newly discovered hoard of dramatic footage filmed at the nuclear plant during the disaster and newly-recorded, deeply personal interviews of those who were there.

videos.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
videos.description: Reconstructing the nine harrowing days following the disaster in forensic, real-time detail, from the control-room engineers fighting to prevent a total meltdown, to the political leaders confronting the unthinkable, to ordinary citizens caught in the fallout. Power plant workers who were tasked with averting a major catastrophe by doing a potential suicide mission. These 50 workers recount the mounting pressures they faced as they entered the darkened reactors to try to avert the worst outcome.

videos.title: Cocktail
videos.description: Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

videos.title: Rain Man
videos.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

videos.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
videos.description: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

videos.title: Deadpool 2
videos.description: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool meets Russell, an angry teenage mutant who lives at an orphanage. When Russell becomes the target of Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future -- Deadpool realizes that he'll need some help saving the boy from such a superior enemy. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other powerful mutants to protect young Russell from Cable and his advanced weaponry.

videos.title: Skyscraper
videos.description: Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno.

videos.description: Marine Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) is assigned to protect Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach) -- a Navajo code talker, the Marines' new secret weapon. Enders' orders are to protect his code talker, but if Yahzee should fall into enemy hands, he's to protect the code at all costs. Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code?

videos.title: Fixer to Fabulous
videos.description: When a California-based wife refuses to live in her husband's old Arkansas cabin built around a trailer, Dave and Jenny step in; as they risk the house collapsing during demo, the Marrs deliver a stunning reno with modern and rustic spaces for both.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.description: Ben and Erin help a family move from a Laurel suburb to the countryside and create a new home; the Napiers aim to design a place with ample outdoor space for the kids, along with a treehouse.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.description: Ben and Erin Napier work with their project manager to renovate a family cabin that her husband built alongside his grandfather; the project focuses on turning the structure into a functional family gathering spot.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.description: Ben's little brother and his wife secretly buy a fixer-upper and plan to renovate it themselves to save money; as they move and race to finish before their third baby arrives, Ben and Erin try to convince them to accept some help.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.description: After countless setbacks, an engaged couple's finally saved enough to renovate their first home together; the house needs more work than expected, and with bats in the attic and a tight budget, they call on Ben and Erin for help.

videos.title: Home Town
videos.description: Two siblings leave their small New York City apartments and are ready to put down Southern roots for a slower pace of life; after showing each of them houses, Ben and Erin are caught off guard when the siblings surprise them with a new plan.
